theme: 허브와 해충 — 생태계와 함께 일하는 정원 가꾸기

overview.topic: 🔎 허브로 해충을 조절하고 생태계 균형과 함께 일하는 정원 관리
overview.stance_reason: There is good news about pests and medicinal herbs
overview.structure_reason: 새 정원 초기에 해충이 밀려오는 문제 → 생태계와 함께 균형을 이루는 해결책 제시

key_grammar.source_sentence: So the more herbs you grow, the more you will attract pollinators and "good" bugs that like to eat the more destructive pests, which will lead to a more successful garden!

explanation.text: 'the + 비교급 ~, the + 비교급 ~'은 '~하면 할수록 더 …하다'라는 비례 관계를 나타낸다.
the more herbs you grow(조건절)와 the more you will attract(주절)가 짝을 이룬다.
각 절에서 비교급 어구가 the와 함께 절의 맨 앞으로 나온다: the more herbs, the more.
뒤의 the more destructive pests와 a more successful garden의 more는 이 구문이 아니라 일반 비교급이다.
, which는 앞 절 전체를 받는 계속적 용법의 관계대명사이다.

key_grammar.example_analysis: the more herbs you grow와 the more you will attract가 짝을 이루는 'the 비교급 the 비교급' 구문이다.

drills.question: 다음 밑줄 친 부분 중, 어법상 적절하지 않은 것은?
drills.sentence: So [[1|the more]] herbs you grow, [[2|the more]] you will attract pollinators and "good" bugs [[3|what]] like to eat the more destructive pests, [[4|which]] will [[5|lead]] to a more successful garden!
drills.fix: 선행사 bugs가 있는 주격 관계대명사가 필요하므로 what이 아니라 원문대로 that이어야 한다.

drills.question: 각 네모 안에서 어법에 맞는 것을 고르시오.
drills.sentence: There is good news about pests and medicinal herbs: Most herbs either repel pests [[or/nor]] attract beneficial insects [[that/what]] help [[keep/keeping]] pest populations in check.
drills.fix: either와 짝을 이루는 or, 선행사 insects가 있는 주격 관계대명사 that, 준사역동사 help 뒤 원형부정사 keep이 맞다.

drills.question: 다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장은?
options: So the first couple years in a new garden can feel like wave after wave of pests are overtaking your plants.
Immediately attempting to remove a new pest entirely from your garden will only further these initial imbalances and lengthen the process of helping your garden grows better on its own.
There is good news about pests and medicinal herbs: Most herbs either repel pests or attract beneficial insects that help keep pest populations in check.
When it comes to managing pests in the garden, it's important to remember that you are altering the ecosystem of an area that existed on its own before you planted anything into it.
The goal of a long-term healthy garden is to work with the environment you are trying to cultivate to allow the plants, pollinators, and even the annoying pests to balance out.
drills.answer: Immediately attempting to remove a new pest entirely from your garden will only further these initial imbalances and lengthen the process of helping your garden grows better on its own.
drills.fix: help+목적어(your garden) 뒤에는 원형부정사가 오므로 grows가 아니라 원문대로 grow가 되어야 한다.

drills.question: 네가 더 많이 연습할수록, 너는 더 빨리 향상될 것이다.
drills.answer: The more you practice, the faster you will improve.

drills.question: 허브를 더 많이 기를수록, 당신은 더 파괴적인 해충을 먹기 좋아하는 수분 매개자와 '좋은' 벌레들을 더 많이 끌어들일 것이고, 이는 더 성공적인 정원으로 이어질 것이다!
drills.answer: So the more herbs you grow, the more you will attract pollinators and "good" bugs that like to eat the more destructive pests, which will lead to a more successful garden!
